messages:
Maya: Heads-up — planning a public announce for Optimize v0.9 on Wed 09:00 PT. Marketing needs final changelog URL, docs link with utm, and one p95 stat + cost-delta for the blog by EOD Tue. Can eng/docs confirm?
Sanjay: Changelog PR merged to main; I'll publish the permalink after docs are live. Current PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/412
Liam: Docs ETA Tue 14:00 PT. We'll publish the Optimize guide and append ?utm_campaign=optimize_v0.9 to the handed-off link.
Olivia: Rollout plan — canary in us-west @ 09:00 PT, 30m observation, then ramp. Canary will be reachable publicly but has limited capacity.
Maya: Can the canary UX match screenshots for the blog? Also confirm p95 and token-cost delta availability.
Samir: Yes, same code path. I'll upload a p95 dashboard screenshot and a 7-day baseline vs v0.9 CSV by Tue 15:00 for design/charting.
Priya: Webinar Thu 10:00 PT landing page needs a short product blurb and CTA. Please ensure any form/webhook includes "tag": "optimize-launch" so SDR routing to inbound-launch-optimize works.
Sanjay: We'll add campaign and tag fields exactly as requested and coordinate with release-bot to include the event schema change in the deploy.
release-bot: Deploy scheduled: service/optimize v0.9 -> canary us-west @ 2025-11-12T09:00:00-08:00; full rollout @ 2025-11-12T09:30:00-08:00. CI: green.
Maya: Perfect. Final marketing asks: drop changelog + docs links here with a two-sentence blurb for social once live. We'll schedule the announce at Wed 09:05 PT. :thumbsup:
